details: Implement DiscoverLintSpecs(specsDir string, filterSpec string) ([]LintSpecInfo, error)
Use os.ReadDir to list specsDir; return error if directory does not exist

Call ParseSpecDirName to extract Prefix and Name; set HasTasks = tasks.json exists, HasPRD = prd.md exists
If filterSpec non-empty, filter results to matching Name; return error if no specs found after filtering
Return error if no specs discovered at all

subtasks.title: Implement RunLintSpecs
details: Implement RunLintSpecs(specsDir string, lintAll bool) (LintResult, error)
Call DiscoverLintSpecs(specsDir, '') to get all specs; propagate error
For each LintSpecInfo: if lintAll=false, call LoadSpec and check if all subtasks in all groups have state 'done' or 'dropped'; skip if fully implemented
For each remaining spec: call LoadSpec then (*Spec).Validate() to get ValidationResult; convert ValidationEntry items to LintFinding with appropriate severity mapping
Collect all findings, call SortFindings, call ComputeExitCode, return LintResult
